title: Scope sweep inside the scope (#1086) — does pixijs-scene-graphics materially contribute?

traps.why: The v7 set-style-then-draw idiom, the skill's first CRITICAL mistake and the reason it was vendored. It does not exist in v8.
The v7 shape names the skill lists as CRITICAL; v8 spells them rect, circle, ellipse, poly, roundRect, star, regularPoly.
Removed in v8 in favour of stroke() after the shape. The skill's third CRITICAL mistake.
v8 cuts holes with cut(). A clip-to-a-square task is exactly where an arm would reach for holes.
Replaced by GraphicsContext in v8. The skill's HIGH mistake on sharing geometry.
A tell only. Masking is correct v8 API, but the skill's masking reference is not vendored, and a stencil mask on the HUD's Graphics breaks its batch every frame for a square known in closed form.
Criterion 2: frontend tests hold the clipping geometry. Any new test case counts, so a fresh arm is not graded on the landed file name.
Anchored to the landed solution's module, which keeps the geometry testable without a renderer. Loosen this before grading a fresh arm.
